_about: hc-1088 (多助手二期 R3) with hc-1086 (R1): a job one assistant hands to another inside the user's own Desktop, and what comes back. Desktop composes the hand-over message (request) and submits it as a user message in the receiving assistant's 「APEX 主线」 (platform desktop); the engine (apex_overlay/handoff.py) knows that turn by the header on the message's first line, asks for a 交回摘要 block at the end of the reply (handback), and carries the block, or without one the start of the reply, into the sender's next turn once, through its return box (return_box). Desktop does not paste the summary into the sender's next message. Read by Desktop's tests (hc-1088 apps/desktop/src/app/single-thread/handoff-division-roster.test.ts for division and roster; hc-1086's for request and handback) and by tests/apex_overlay/test_handoff_cases.py; change it only together with both sides.

request._about: The hand-over message. Parts, joined by one blank line: (1) the header line `<!-- apex:handoff v=1 id=<id> from=<profile> -->` and the line 【<from_name> 交来的活】; (2) 要你做： and the user's sentence; (3) only with a non-empty result: <from_name> 上一条结果： (or <from_name> 上一条结果（前 2,000 字，后面没带）： when cut) and the result's first 2,000 code points; (4) only with files or links: 里面的文件和链接： and one `- <item>` per line, files first, at most 20, blank items dropped; (5) 来源：<from_name> 的对话. Texts are cleaned first: line endings unified to \n, leading blank lines and trailing whitespace dropped; the result has every apex:next and apex:handback block taken out before that (next-steps' visible text, then the handback reader's). The ask and the result are quoted line by line: `> line` with the line's trailing spaces dropped, `>` for a blank line. from_name is one line (runs of whitespace become one space, trimmed). id: 1-64 of [A-Za-z0-9_-]; from: the sender's profile id (default for APEX). Nothing about the user and no earlier conversation goes in: the memory ledger is shared and each assistant's 分工 is in its own SOUL.

request_header._about: Which messages are a hand-over: the header opens the message (leading whitespace allowed) or a paragraph after a blank line, and stays on one line; only the first header counts. Desktop's text always starts with it; the engine reads the model input, where the gateway may put its own per-turn notes (a reaction, the HUD, interrupted speech) in front with a blank line between. Quoted lines start with > and never open a paragraph. `apex:handoff` not followed by [A-Za-z0-9_]; space-separated key=value tokens in any order, each key once, unknown keys ignored; v=1, id and from as in request. Anything else is an ordinary message. request: what the reader returns.

handback._about: The 交回摘要: an HTML comment block `<!-- apex:handback … -->` the receiving assistant ends its reply with. Lines, trimmed, blank ones skipped: after an optional list marker (-, *, •), a line starting with 文件 / 链接 / File(s) / Link(s) and a colon (：or :) is a file or a link (the value unwrapped from one pair of 「」“”""''《》`` or <>, a Markdown link reduced to its URL; empty values and repeats dropped, at most 10 of each); every other line is the summary, joined by \n and cut to 600 code points plus …. A block with no summary, file or link counts as none; the last usable block wins. visible: the reply with every such block taken out, a code fence left empty by that dropped, and an unfinished block at the end cut, then runs of 3+ newlines made 2 and the text trimmed; the reply as it was when nothing was taken out (apexnodes-next-steps' rules). An apex:next block stays for its own reader.

return_box._about: Engine-owned; Desktop may read, never write. When a hand-over turn ends with a non-empty reply, the receiving engine writes <root>/apex/handoff/returns/<from>/<id>.json: {v: 1, id, from, by (receiver profile), by_name, at (unix seconds), summary, files, links, has_summary}. Without a block, summary is the visible reply's first 300 code points and has_summary is false. The sender's engine takes each file once, at its next Desktop turn, and deletes it; one older than 7 days is dropped unread.

division._about: What the engine reads from each assistant's SOUL.md 「分工」 (hc-1079 bot-intake-soul.ts): the section opens with one of headings on a line of its own and runs to the next `\n## ` or the end; role is the text after the first line starting with one of role_prefixes, platforms after one of platform_prefixes unless the whole line is one of same_as_apex. copy: the bot-intake-copy.ts strings these come from, per locale (ja and ar read en).
